tools.name: studio_connection
tools.description: Whether a Strōq World Studio tab is connected to this relay. When none is, it gives the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to tell the person: in the Studio, Tools → AI agent → Connect…, paste it, switch Connect on. The Studio tools appear once the tab connects.

tools.name: wait_for_comments
tools.description: Waits for comments and Asks from the person in the Studio and returns them; works before the tab has paired too (it waits for the pairing first). Returns within 45 s; "nothing new" means call it again. Use it as a loop: handle each one (ack_comment, get_comment, do the work, reply_comment), then call wait_for_comments again, until the person stops you.

instructions: Tools of an open Strōq World Studio tab, relayed. If no tab is connected yet, call studio_connection and tell the person the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to paste under Tools → AI agent → Connect…. This agent owns the Studio's comments and Asks, and the person expects answers without prompting you again: Call wait_for_comments, and keep calling it in a loop: each call returns within about 50 s, either with the comments and Asks waiting (for each: ack_comment straight away, get_comment for the picture and thread, do the work, reply_comment saying what changed) or with "nothing new", and then you call it again. Keep looping until the person tells you to stop.
